In Settings, go to Personalization, then Memory. Open Memory summary or Saved memories. Delete the items you want removed. Deleting a chat doesn't delete the memories saved from it. 6. Go back to Data Controls and scroll to Marketing Privacy. To opt out, turn off both marketing switches if they’re shown. 7. To close your account for good, go to Settings, then Account.
